sec: Life cycle of HBV, cccDNA note, acute hepatitis treatment indications, histology

items.q: Fill up (Life cycle): the sub genomic mRNA is translated to give the ______ protein / ______ antigen, which is labelled carcinogenic.
items.exp: '① Sub genomic mRNA → Translation → x-Protein → HbxAg (Carcinogenic)'. (Book p1042)

items.q: Life cycle — match — 1) Pre genomic mRNA 2) DNA … A) DNA dependent DNA polymerase B) RNA dependent DNA polymerase (reverse transcriptase)
items.exp: '(a) Pre genomic mRNA' leads to 'RNA dependent DNA polymerase (Reverse transcriptase)' → DNA, then 'DNA dependent DNA polymerase'. (Book p1042)

items.q: Judge the life-cycle diagram: I The pre-genomic RNA step needs the viral RNA-dependent DNA polymerase (reverse transcriptase). II The host enzyme is shown acting on the sub-genomic mRNA branch.
items.exp: '+ Host enzyme' is drawn on the sub-genomic (x-protein) branch; the pre-genomic branch runs through reverse transcriptase. (Book p1042)

items.q: Which receptor is printed for entry of the Dane particle into the hepatocyte?
Fill up: the nuclear form printed in the life cycle is ______ (cccDNA), and its strands are labelled ______.
Judge the printed note: I Integration of HBV cccDNA with the host genome makes eradication impossible. II It confers a risk of malignancy.
items.exp: 'Note : HBV cccDNA integration with host genome makes it impossible to eradicate. Confers risk of malignancy.' (Book p1042)

items.q: Which viral product is specifically flagged as carcinogenic in the life-cycle diagram?
Indication of treatment in acute hepatitis B — the bilirubin criterion as printed?
opts: S. bilirubin > 10 mg/dl at any time
items.exp: 'Acute hepatitis : Indication of treatment : · S. Bilirubin > 3 mg/dl for 4 weeks'. (Book p1042)

items.q: The second treatment indication printed for acute hepatitis B?
items.exp: 'INR ≥ 1.5' is the second indication listed. (Book p1042)

items.q: Judge the treatment indications for acute hepatitis B: I Serum bilirubin above 3 mg/dl persisting for 4 weeks. II INR of 1.5 or more.
items.exp: Both are printed under 'Acute hepatitis : Indication of treatment'. (Book p1042)

items.q: Histology captions — match — 1) H&E 2) Immunohistochemistry … A) Immunohistochemical stain for HBsAg showing brownish inclusion B) Hepatocytes with ground glass inclusions
items.exp: 'Hepatocytes with ground glass inclusions' and 'Immunohistochemical stain for HBsAg showing brownish inclusion'. (Book p1042)

items.q: Which stain is used to demonstrate the ground-glass hepatocytes of HBV on this page?
items.exp: The paired caption reads 'Immunohistochemical stain for HBsAg showing brownish inclusion'. (Book p1042)
